Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Supply Chain Manager, Strategic Initiatives and Digitalization.
 Lead the development and execution of Supply Chain and Procurement strategic initiatives and the SCM digitalization roadmap across EMEA. Translate functional priorities into a governed portfolio of projects that improve efficiency, process excellence, data transparency and decision-making. Partner with the VP, leadership team and process owners to deliver sustainable business value, and lead the Supply Chain Digitalization Specialist in implementing and sustaining approved digital solutions.
Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve :
Coordinate strategy development and review with Supply Chain and Procurement leaders; identify needs, risks and improvement opportunities.
Define the strategy review process; facilitate workshops, cross-functional exchange and management presentations.
Structure and prioritize strategic initiatives and the SCM digitalization roadmap by business impact, feasibility, risk and capacity.
Independently lead assigned strategic projects, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and stakeholder communication.
Establish governance and follow-up with the VP and extended leadership team; prepare business cases, decision papers and progress reports.
Lead and coach the Supply Chain Digitalization Specialist; set priorities, objectives and delivery expectations, allocate work and develop capability.
Translate SCM priorities into requirements and acceptance criteria with process owners; oversee delivery, testing, deployment, documentation, adoption and ongoing ownership.
Sponsor Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, Microsoft Copilot and approved AI use cases; align technology choices and data access with IT and data owners.
Ensure data quality, security, privacy, access management and maintainability; escalate technical and architecture decisions to accountable IT or system owners.
Track outcomes and realized benefits with Finance and process owners; resolve delivery barriers and escalate risks requiring leadership decisions.
 If You Have/are
 Functional Competencies
In-depth understanding of Supply Chain and Procurement processes, excellence priorities and business needs.
Strategic approaches and methodologies; portfolio prioritization, project management and strategy execution.
Business-case development, analytical problem-solving, benefit tracking and management reporting.
Process improvement, change management, workshop facilitation and stakeholder influence.
Working understanding of Power BI, Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot and approved AI use cases sufficient to evaluate value, requirements, risks and delivery options with specialists.
Understanding of data quality, data connections, access, governance and enterprise-system dependencies; ability to work effectively with IT and data owners.
 Personal Characteristics Enabling Success
Strategic, analytical and solution-oriented, with strong ownership and a business-value mindset.
Motivates and guides team members, builds trust with business and technical partners, and secures buy-in through functional leadership.
Communicates effectively at all hierarchy levels, manages differing stakeholder expectations with resilience, anticipates issues and creates momentum.
Organizes multiple priorities effectively and combines independent judgment with collaborative decision-making.
 Education
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration or a related field.
 Previous Experience
Understanding of data quality, data connections, access, governance and enterprise-system dependencies; ability to work effectively with IT and data owners.
3+ years of relevant project-management and strategy-execution experience, preferably in an industrial Supply Chain and/or Procurement environment.
Experience structuring and delivering cross-functional initiatives and communicating with senior stakeholders.
For the expanded digitalization remit: experience translating business priorities into digital or process-improvement initiatives and supporting adoption and benefit realization.
Ability to lead and coach team members and coordinate specialist contributions.
 Languages
Fluent English, written and spoken. Additional languages are an advantage.
 Other
Ability to work across functions, countries and time zones and to handle confidential business data in line with security, privacy and access requirements. Travel expectations should be confirmed for the manager role.
 We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
 In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
 More lives saved – more life lived!
